reason: Two hundred and ninety-nine rupees is nothing for me, but the first thing I thought was that affiliate links might make my audience trust me less. I would have to see it prove itself on my own channel before paying, and I rarely open a laptop anyway, so I would not set it up in a normal week.
objection: If Mitra pushes affiliate products or local deals, my viewers may feel I am selling out, and one bad recommendation can cost me subscribers I spent years building.
would_change_my_mind: Using it free for a few weeks and seeing it clearly beat my usual views with no product pushed on my audience, and the deal fees staying optional and visible.
